subject: 明代北方府城：王府殿院模块（原创扩展）；具体构件断代（待考）。
footprint_basis: design/22 §3.4 明代对应骨架；本套件地域命名
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Turn this EXACT parallelogram into a thin paved foundation supporting a Ming northern Chinese princely courtyard palace module. Keep the precise existing outer silhouette, composition and footprint at pixel positions left168,570 rear708,300 right1368,630 front828,900 on this1536x1152canvas. The diagonals must stay exactly at+/-0.5 slope. DO NOT lengthen or narrow the shape. This is a22by18metre rectangle in2:1orthographicdimetricprojection. Add finely realistic weatheredgraystone paving entirely INSIDE shape, then build the small enclosure within it, preserving the three visible foundation corners. Front red-plaster enclosure with central wooden gate; rear ceremonial hall has green glazed tiles, restrained Ming painted beams and red columns; two side wings have grey hard-gabled roofs. This is one modest princely residence courtyard module, no imperial yellow roofs. Photorealistic painted strategy-game building, fine greybrick/tile/woodgrain materials, natural left-upper light. No people, writing, labels, signs, watermark, modern items. True transparent background. Entire building fits in image with generous transparent margins. Do not hide or alter thin foundation silhouette; footprint is the highest priority and must not warp.

references.role: 精确几何参考；已view_image；仅供image_gen重建

visual_review: 第2轮逐张view_image两候选，选本轮整体较优图；主体、底角完整，RGBA透明，光源左上。实测斜率与宽深比见repair-r2记录，仍未同时达到审核几何阈值，保留candidate；未做仿射或透视纠偏。
source_point_semantics: 可见薄石基脚L/F/R外缘顶点；取alpha>200下轮廓辅助定位，屋檐、台阶不作占地角
selection_reason: 两候选内优先保留形制与材料，并兼顾斜率和比例；未达标如实登记
negative: 排除项完整内嵌于prompt；工具无独立negative参数。
final_view_image_review: 第2轮已逐张view_image规范化成品：轮廓及底面完整，透明留边，左上光向、纹理密度可读；几何仍有已登记残差，尚不通过严格审核。
